description: Search the configured mailbox: server-side IMAP filter, headers newest-first. For this profile's own email account (the EMAIL_* secrets). Returns UID, sender name/address, subject, date, read state; no message bodies are downloaded. Follow with email_read using a returned UID.
name: email_search

folder.description: Folder to search (default INBOX). Run email_folders for valid names.

limit.description: Max messages to return (newest first). Default 20, max 50.

sender.description: Match the From header against this substring.

since.description: Received since: YYYY-MM-DD, or Nd meaning N days back (e.g. 7d).

subject.description: Match the Subject header against this substring.

unread_only.description: Only messages not yet read (UNSEEN). Default false.
